zh.headline: Meta 发布 Muse Glimmer：Apache 2.0 许可的 30B 开源 Agent 模型，可在消费级硬件运行
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是 Meta 以 Muse Glimmer 强势回归开源阵营，Apache 2.0 许可 + 30B 参数 + 消费级硬件可运行，直接挑战 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的封闭策略。扎克伯格公开为蒸馏辩护，标志着"蒸馏-开源-再蒸馏"的循环正在加速，模型能力的扩散速度将远超预期。与此同时，Agent 安全问题从理论讨论走向真实事故——健身房预约事件和 Rovo 数据窃取漏洞表明，授权边界和输入隔离已成为 Agent 落地的最大瓶颈。最后，OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6-Cyber 和 Google 的 WeatherNext 展示了 AI 在安全防御和科学计算等垂直领域的深度渗透，AI 正从通用工具演变为关键基础设施。

en.headline: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer: Apache 2.0 Licensed 30B Open Agent Model Running on Consumer Hardware
en.observation: The most significant signal today is Meta's aggressive return to open source with Muse Glimmer — Apache 2.0 license, 30B parameters, consumer-hardware-runnable — directly challenging the closed strategies of OpenAI and Anthropic. Zuckerberg's public defense of distillation signals that the "distill-open-distill" loop is accelerating, and model capability diffusion will far outpace expectations. Meanwhile, agent safety issues have moved from theoretical discussion to real incidents — the gym reservation hack and the Rovo data theft vulnerability show that authorization boundaries and input isolation are now the biggest bottlenecks to agent deployment. Finally, OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber and Google's WeatherNext demonstrate AI's deep penetration into vertical domains like security defense and scientific computing — AI is evolving from a general-purpose tool into critical infrastructure.
